parts.text:
The years in which there were cars produced that weighed less than 4000 **and** also cars that weighed more than 3000 are:

| Year |
|------|
| 1970 |
| 1971 |
| 1972 |
| 1973 |
| 1974 |
| 1975 |
| 1976 |
| 1977 |
| 1978 |
| 1979 |
| 1980 |
| 1981 |
| 1982 |

All 13 years in the dataset (1970–1982) satisfy both conditions.
